_comment: NONE of these files are redistributed with this repository. Every candidate
dataset repository carries NO open-source licence, so committing the raw data
would be a licence violation. scripts/fetch_datasets.py downloads them into
.cache/ (gitignored) and verifies the SHA-256 recorded here, so results stay
Use of this data is limited to non-commercial research and education. Cite the

datasets.name: transformer-fault-dataset
notes: 211 of 589 rows carry C2H2 = 1e-4, a sentinel for below-detection-limit.
The reference paper reports 7 exact-duplicate groups (14 rows) and 5
cross-label exact collisions. Deduplication is left to the caller.

datasets.name: DGA
notes: Carries a duplicated header row; the header is on row index 1.
The only candidate dataset with a Normal class, which makes it the one
that exposes methods unable to report a healthy unit.
中低温过热 merges two IEC thermal tiers; mapped to T1 (lossy).
